Empty states per tab with the relevant next-action CTA (e.g., To List empty → 'Intake an item')

userStories.title: Sold tab: payout status, ROI, ship-by countdown, repeat-buyer flags

Sold tab in listings.tsx: dedicated columns (sold$ / net / margin% / payout state / ship-by countdown / repeat-buyer star). Payout state inferred without US-125 (payout amount present = cleared; fees >20% of sale = discrepancy). Ship-by from sold_at + 3-day default handling window (red <24h or overdue, amber <48h, green otherwise). Repeat-buyer star when buyer_id has >1 sale. Filter chips: All / Awaiting payout / Discrepancy / 7d / 30d / YTD. Aggregate strip: count / gross / net / avg margin%. Bulk Mark-Shipped (reuses selection infra). 'Print label' eBay deep-link deferred — needs per-order eBay URL from US-122 sync.

userStories.title: Postgres full-text search across items, listings, sales notes

acceptanceCriteria: Migration 00016 adds tsvector generated columns: inventory_items.search_vec, listings.search_vec, sales.search_vec

Vector weights: title=A, brand/sku=B, description=C, notes=D
RPC flipdesk_search(query text, scope text DEFAULT 'all', limit int DEFAULT 50) returns unified result rows (type · id · title · snippet · rank)
Snippet uses ts_headline with HTML highlight (<mark>)
Query parser supports quoted phrases, AND/OR (default AND), and field-scoped queries (brand:Nike, sku:GT-1234, status:active)
Command palette (US-142) and Listings page (US-138) both use this RPC
RLS still enforced — function is SECURITY INVOKER
Typecheck + lint pass
userStories.notes: Completed. Migration 00016: weighted tsvector GENERATED columns on inventory_items (title A / brand+sku B / description C / notes D), listings (title A / description C), sales (buyer B) + GIN indexes. RPC flipdesk_search(query, scope, limit) — websearch_to_tsquery + ts_headline <mark> highlight, UNION ALL across the three tables, ranked, SECURITY INVOKER so RLS filters to the caller's rows. Command palette wired: debounced 250ms RPC call adds a 'Full-text matches' section (deduped against the cached client-side Items section). Snippet renderer splits on <mark> and renders non-marked text as escaped React text — no XSS from user content. Field-scoped queries (brand:Nike) not parsed — websearch_to_tsquery handles quoted phrases + OR; field prefixes are a later enhancement. Listings-page wiring skipped — US-143 filter builder already covers that surface.

userStories.notes: Completed. /dashboard/flipdesk/grid (src/pages/flipdesk/grid.tsx). Editable grid of inventory_items: SKU/Title/Brand/Style/Size/Cost/Target/Notes. userStories.title: Google Sheets 2-way live sync (push + pull + conflict resolution)
userStories.description: As a reseller, I need my FlipDesk inventory mirrored to Google Sheets and edits made in Sheets to flow back to FlipDesk so my team and accountant can work where they're comfortable.
acceptanceCriteria: Sheet structure auto-created: tabs 'Inventory', 'Listings', 'Sales', 'Sources', 'Sync Log' with header row + frozen first row + data validation on enum columns (status, category)
Each row carries a hidden flipdesk_id column (UUID) as the join key
POST /api/flipdesk/google/sync/push (internal job auth) writes changed FlipDesk rows since last_sync_at to the sheet via batchUpdate
POST /api/flipdesk/google/sync/pull reads the sheet, diffs against DB by flipdesk_id, applies updates with field-level merge

Conflict resolution: if both sides changed the same field since last_sync_at, FlipDesk wins by default but the row is flagged in a Conflicts tab with both values + 'Accept Sheet / Accept FlipDesk' actions
Sync frequency: every 5 min via scheduler (US-131); also exposed as a manual 'Sync now' button
Sync Log tab records each run: timestamp, rows pushed, rows pulled, conflicts, errors
Per-field allow-list: only writable-from-Sheets fields are pulled (title, brand, size, cost_basis, target_price, sku, notes, status) — financial/system fields read-only in sheet (light gray fill)
Rate-limited and chunked to stay under Sheets API quota (300 req/min/user)
Typecheck + lint pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-146. The conflict tab is the key UX — silent overwrite either way will burn trust fast. Field allow-list keeps users from corrupting computed fields like net_profit.

userStories.title: 3-way reconciliation (FlipDesk ↔ eBay ↔ Google Sheets) with conflict UI

Migration 00018: flipdesk_sync_conflicts (id, user_id, listing_id, field_name, flipdesk_value, ebay_value, sheets_value, detected_at, resolved_at, resolution)
Email notification (via existing notification system) when conflict count crosses user-configured threshold
